scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix apps/cloud-api install && npm --prefix apps/web install && npm --prefix apps/desktop install && npm --prefix apps/cloud-api run env:init && npm --prefix apps/cloud-api run prisma:generate && concurrently -k -s first -n db,init "npm --prefix apps/cloud-api run db" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5544 && npm --prefix apps/cloud-api run db:reset"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n db,api,web -c gray,cyan,blue "npm --prefix apps/cloud-api run db" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5544 && npm --prefix apps/cloud-api run db:migrate && npm --prefix apps/cloud-api run dev" "npm --prefix apps/web run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/cloud-api test && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck
